welcome: Heading of the sign-in screen, shown before signing in to Socio.
sign-in-to: {{name}} is the workspace's name (its brand), or Socio.
passkey: Button on the sign-in screen: signs in with a passkey saved on the device.
provider: {{name}} is a sign-in provider such as Google or GitHub; don't translate it.
send-link: Button: the server sends a one-time sign-in link to the person's Telegram.
form: Screen-reader label of the email and password form.
name: Accessible name of the name field on the sign-in screen's create-account form.
name-placeholder: Placeholder of the name field when creating an account.
email: Label and placeholder of the email address field on the sign-in screen.
password: Label and placeholder of the password field on the sign-in screen.
send-reset: Submit button of the forgot-password form: emails a link to set a new password.
create-account: Submit button of the create-account form.
sign-in: Submit button of the sign-in form.
forgot: Link under the sign-in form: switches to the form that sends a password reset link.
sign-up: Link under the sign-in form: switches to the form for creating a new account.
back: Link on the forgot-password and create-account forms: back to the sign-in form.
invite-only: Shown when people can't sign up themselves.
invite-only-reset: The same, when the server can't email a password reset: an admin can send a link to set a new password.
link-sent: After asking for a sign-in link. Telegram is the messaging app; don't translate it.
reset-sent: Shown after asking for a password reset link. It doesn't say whether the address has an account, on purpose.
password-set: Shown on the sign-in screen after a new password was set.
mock.title: Heading of the development sign-in that lists test accounts. Playful.
mock.choose: Under the heading of the development sign-in that lists test accounts.
mock.continue: Button per test account; {{name}} is the account's name.
mock.warning: Warning on the development sign-in, which is used only on test servers.
link.title: Heading of the page a one-time sign-in link opens. "Socio" is the product name.
link.once: On the page a one-time sign-in link opens: how long and how often the link works.
link.continue: Button on the page a one-time sign-in link opens: signs in.
link.unasked: For someone who opened a link they didn't ask for.
set-password.title: Heading of the page an invite or reset link opens.
set-password.rules: Under the heading of the page that sets a new password: the password rules.
set-password.differ: Error when the two password fields don't match.
set-password.failed: Error when setting the new password failed and the server gave no reason.
set-password.new: Accessible name of the new password field.
set-password.repeat: Accessible name of the field where the new password is typed again.
set-password.submit: Button that saves the new password.
errors.unreachable: Error on the sign-in screen when the server could not be reached.
errors.users: Error on the development sign-in when its list of test accounts could not load.
errors.sign-in: Error on the sign-in screen when signing in failed and the server gave no reason.
errors.not-invited: Error after signing in with an account the workspace hasn't invited.
errors.state: After a sign-in with a provider (Google…) that expired or started in another browser.
errors.link-used: Error after opening a one-time sign-in link that was already used or is too old.
errors.method-off: That sign-in method is turned off on this server; an operator runs the server.
errors.not-linked: The provider (Google…) didn't confirm the email address of an existing account.
social: Button on the website's sign-in screen; {{name}} is Google or Apple, brand names not to translate.
social-errors.canceled: After the person canceled at Google's or Apple's sign-in.
social-errors.nonce-invalid: After a Google or Apple sign-in on the website that can't be used: too old, used already, or begun in another browser.
social-errors.not-linked: After a Google or Apple sign-in on the website for an account nobody here linked. Links are made in Settings, by a person already signed in.
errors.failed: Generic error on the sign-in screen when no specific reason is known.
